# remembers

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:remembers`](gmeow-remembers.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/remembers>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/cognition`](../../slices/cognition.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Objectual memory-of: an agent remembers a SUBJECT (a person, place, topic, or event it has encountered). Sub-property of [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md) — remembering a subject entails awareness of it. Distinct from [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](../classes/gmeow-MemoryItem.md) (the ai slice), which is a remembered CLAIM (propositional); this is remembering the thing, not a proposition about it. Bridge, documented NOT axiomatised ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)): an agent's [`gmeow:remembers`](gmeow-remembers.md) edges are typically backed by [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](../classes/gmeow-MemoryItem.md) observations about the subject and surfaced by the flagship's recall — see [`gmeow:memoryOf`](gmeow-memoryOf.md). Forgetting is suppression ([`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false / closed scope), never deletion ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for objectual memory — an agent remembering a SUBJECT (a person, place, topic, or event it has encountered), the recall surface the agent-memory flagship reads ([Principle 15](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-15)); it entails [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md) by subproperty.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for a remembered CLAIM or proposition (that is [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](../classes/gmeow-MemoryItem.md), the ai slice — this is remembering the thing, not a fact about it) and avoid DELETING a remembers edge to model forgetting; suppress it with [`gmeow:displayable`](gmeow-displayable.md) false or a closed scope ([Principle 10](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-10)).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:remembers`](gmeow-remembers.md) from agent to subject (it entails [`gmeow:isAwareOf`](gmeow-isAwareOf.md)); bridge to backing [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](../classes/gmeow-MemoryItem.md) observations through [`gmeow:memoryOf`](gmeow-memoryOf.md) as documentation (no axiom, no ai-slice dependency), and model forgetting as suppression, never deletion.

### Scope notes

- Boundary: objectual [`gmeow:remembers`](gmeow-remembers.md) (a remembered subject) ⊥ propositional [`gmeow:MemoryItem`](../classes/gmeow-MemoryItem.md) (a remembered claim, ai slice). The link is a documented bridge through [`gmeow:memoryOf`](gmeow-memoryOf.md), not an axiom; cognition asserts no dependency on the ai slice ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).
